description_en: Queries attack defense events for the China region China map
description_zh: 查询大屏攻击防御事件
name: DescribeScreenAttackAnalysisData

parameters.help_en:
The type of attack analysis details. Valid values:

TOTAL: attack count
TREND: attack trend
PIE_CHART: attack type distribution
SOURCE_TOP: top 5 attack sources
CLIENT_TOP: top 5 attacked assets
DETAILS: attack details list

When Type is set to DETAILS, pagination parameters are required
parameters.help_zh:
攻击分析的详情。取值：

TOTAL：攻击次数
TREND：攻击趋势
PIE_CHART：攻击类型分布
SOURCE_TOP：攻击来源TOP 5
CLIENT_TOP：被攻击资产TOP 5
DETAILS：攻击详情列表

当Type取值为DETAILS时，分页参数为必填项
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp that specifies the start time of the attack, in seconds.
The start time can be up to 40 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh:
攻击开始的时间戳，单位为秒。
开始时间只能为近40天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The timestamp that specifies the end time of the attack, in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 攻击结束的时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions for attack events.
Description of the crack_type field values:
3: MySQL brute-force attacks
4: FTP brute-force attacks
5: SSH brute-force attacks
6: RDP brute-force attacks
9: SQL Server brute-force attacks
101: Java Struts2 attack interception
102: Redis attack interception
103: China Ant Sword WebShell communication
104: China Chopper WebShell communication
133: XISE WebShell communication
sqli: SQL injection
codei: code execution
xss: XSS attack
lfi: local file inclusion (LFI)
rfi: remote file inclusion (RFI)
webshell: script trojan
upload: upload vulnerability
path: directory traversal
bypass: unauthorized access
csrf: CSRF
crlf: CRLF
other: other
parameters.help_zh:

sqli：SQL注入
codei：代码执行

parameters.name: data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to Base64-encode the client_url field in the query result. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果是否需要对client_url进行Base64编码。取值：

true：需要
false：不需要
parameters.name: base64

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the page to return. The value starts from 1.

This parameter is required when Type is set to DETAILS.
This parameter cannot be specified when Type is not set to DETAILS
parameters.help_zh:
设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。起始值为1。

当Type取值为DETAILS时，该参数为必填。
当Type取值不为DETAILS时，该参数不能填
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
Settings for paged query. The number of attack event entries to return on each page during paging.
This parameter is required when Type is set to DETAILS
parameters.help_zh:
设置分页查询时，每页显示的攻击事件信息的数量。
当Type取值为DETAILS时，该参数为必填
parameters.name: page_size

Data.description_en:
The list of attack events. The following fields are included:

client_url: the URL of the attack request.
internetIp: the IP address of the asset instance.
instanceName: the name of the asset instance.
table_src: the data source.
uuid: the UUID of the asset instance.
crack_method: the method of the attack request.
crack_hour: the Attack Time.
crack_src_ip: the IP address of the attacker.
instanceId: the instance ID.
dst_port: the attacked port.
client_ip: the attacked IP address.
location: the region of the attacker.
aliuid: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
crack_cnt: the number of attacks.
crack_type: the attack type. Valid values:
    - 113: improper permissions
    - 112: redirect attack
    - upload: upload vulnerability
    - other: other
    - webshell: script trojan
    - 201: abnormal connection attack
    - 9: SQL Server brute-force attacks
    - 5: SSH brute-force attacks

    - sqli: SQL injection
    - 209: web attack

    - 3: MySQL brute-force attacks
    - 30: clickjacking
    - 4: FTP brute-force attacks
    - bypass: unauthorized access
    - 33: format character string attack
    - deeplearning: other
    - 32: integer overflow attack
    - 203: brute-force attacks
    - 34: race condition
    - rfi: remote file inclusion (RFI)
    - 0: SQL injection attack
    - 212: mining behavior
    - 213: reverse shell attack
    - 211: worm request
    - 61: timeout attack
    - 20: directory traversal attack
    - xss: cross-site scripting (XSS) attack
    - 22: authorization bypass attack

    - 26: file delete attack
    - 25: file read attack
    - 28: CRLF injection attack
    - 27: logic error
    - 29: template injection attack
    - csrf: CSRF
    - path: directory traversal
    - crlf: CRLF
    - 102: CSRF cross-site request forgery attack
    - 103: server-side request forgery (SSRF) attack
    - 101: cross-site scripting (XSS) attack

Page.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of attack event entries returned on each page during paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 attack event entries are returned on each page during paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的攻击事件信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条攻击事件信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Total.description_en: The total number of attack events returned
Total.description_zh: 查询到的已发生的攻击事件的总条数
